name: Sylvester Smith
role: Early elder, high councilor, and Seventy president
dateNote: Section 75 named him in January 1832, and section 102 lists him on the high council in February 1834.
importance: Sylvester Smith lived at Amherst, Ohio, and joined by June 1831; section 75 pairs him with Gideon Carter for a mission. Section 102 lists him on the first Kirtland high council. During the 1834 march to Missouri he clashed with Joseph Smith, and later confessed to false charges. He became a president of the Seventy in 1835 and had left the Church by 1838.
connections: His named companion is Gideon Carter (75:34). He served on the high council with Oliver Cowdery, Joseph Coe, and others.

sources.title: Sylvester Smith, Joseph Smith Papers biography

reviewNote: Dates and roles checked on JSP. He was not a relative of Joseph Smith as far as JSP shows (parents Chileab Smith and Nancy Marshall).
